text:
zoe: Quick heads-up  onboarding friction spike from the getting-started README. A few snippet bugs: the cURL example uses single quotes (breaks in PowerShell), Node fetch snippet references REDWOOD_TOKEN, Go example reads REDWOOD_OLD_KEY, and the quickstart says "SDK retries handled" but no defaults listed. Seeing support tickets.

matt: Repro'd on Win pwsh. Failing curl (env var not expanded):

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

PowerShell treats single quotes literally so $REDWOOD_API_KEY doesn't expand.

anya: Proposed fixes: 1) show both POSIX and PowerShell variants inline; 2) standardize env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY across all snippets and add a changelog note for old names; 3) add a tiny retry-defaults row in troubleshooting.

lia: PowerShell alternative suggestion:

```powershell
$body = @{ input = 'hello' } | ConvertTo-Json
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -Headers @{ Authorization = "Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY" } -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json'
```

Also: Node snippet currently: `Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN}``. Change to REDWOOD_API_KEY.

matt: I also found Go sample uses `os.Getenv("REDWOOD_OLD_KEY")`. Will update to `REDWOOD_API_KEY` and add a short migration note in the changelog. Rust example: missing #[tokio::main] on async main — quick fix is to add the attribute or show a blocking reqwest example for minimal friction.

zoe: For retries, let's add a small table in troubleshooting: Node: off by default (show how to opt in), Python: 3 retries, Go: 2 retries. Link to a new SDK retry policies page. That should reduce "why didn't my request retry" tickets.

matt: Action items for me: PR with POSIX + pwsh curl forms, align env var across language snippets, add changelog entry for legacy env var, and include retry defaults table. I'll include minimal smoke-test notes (bash, pwsh, node, python, cargo) in the PR description.

lia: I'll update onboarding email snippets and the quickstart landing blurb to call out OS/terminal differences.

devex-bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/3210 and draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 (assigned to @matt).

matt: Will pick this up today and ping support after merge. :thumbsup:
